name: Texas Hill Country
about: Spring (Mar–Apr) brings bluebonnet wildflowers and mild weather, the most popular season; summer (Jun–Sep) is brutally hot, best endured at the region's spring-fed swimming holes.
overview: Fredericksburg's German heritage and growing wine trail, legendary Texas BBQ, spring-fed swimming holes, and Austin's live-music energy just up the road — the hill country west of Austin, at its best when the bluebonnets bloom.
costOverview: Texas BBQ and sweet tea stay properly cheap even at legendary spots — Fredericksburg's wine trail is the real regional splurge.

specialSeasons.text: Texas bluebonnets and other wildflowers carpet the Hill Country roadsides — a beloved, genuinely spectacular seasonal spectacle.
